description: This file defines the MigraDocPrintDocument class, a specialized implementation of System.Drawing.Printing.PrintDocument for rendering and printing MigraDoc documents, including handling print settings, page rendering, and device context adjustments.

classes.name: MigraDocPrintDocument
classes.description: A class that extends PrintDocument to facilitate printing of MigraDoc documents, managing rendering, page settings, and print events.

methods.name: MigraDocPrintDocument
methods.description: Constructor initializing the print document, optionally with a DocumentRenderer.

methods.name: Renderer
methods.description: Property to get or set the DocumentRenderer responsible for rendering pages.

methods.name: SelectedPage
methods.description: Property to get or set the specific page to print when using print range selection.

methods.name: OnBeginPrint
methods.description: Handles initialization before printing starts, setting up page range based on print settings.

methods.name: OnQueryPageSettings
methods.description: Adjusts page settings such as orientation before each page is printed.

methods.name: OnPrintPage
methods.description: Handles rendering of each page, including device context adjustments and invoking the renderer.
